name: Starteck Finance Limited
summary: Starteck Finance Limited functions as an Indian non-banking financial corporation (NBFC), providing diverse funding options. It caters to a wide spectrum of clients, including individual consumers, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and larger commercial customers situated predominantly in India's urban and semi-urban localities. Established in 1985, the company's main office is located in Mumbai, India. It was formerly known as Nivedita Mercantile and Financing Limited, changing its official name to Starteck Finance Limited in November 2018.
